scenes.name: A ROOT AS A PAIR
lines: Root two and the golden ratio never need the real line.
√2 与黄金比都不需要整条实数轴。
Take two fractions, p and q, and read the pair as p plus q alpha.
取两个分数 p 与 q，把这一对读作 p + qα。
Add one rule: alpha squared is b alpha plus c. Multiplying is expanding, then using the rule.
再加一条规则：α² = bα + c。相乘就是展开，再套用这条规则。
That is QuadPoly b c: finite arithmetic, nothing infinite.
这就是 QuadPoly(b, c)：有限步运算，没有任何无穷。

scenes.name: CONJUGATE AND NORM
lines: Every pair has a conjugate. Multiply by it, and the alpha part cancels.
每个数对都有共轭。与它相乘，α 的部分恰好消去。
What is left is one fraction, the norm.
剩下的是一个分数：范数。
Conjugate over norm is the exact inverse: in root two, one, one has norm minus one and inverse minus one, one.
共轭除以范数就是精确的逆元：在 √2 域中，(1, 1) 的范数是 −1，逆元是 (−1, 1)。
Lean checks the inverse whenever the norm is not zero.
Lean 检验：只要范数不为零，这个逆元就成立。

scenes.name: EIGHT BEATS
lines: Set b to zero and c to two: delta squares to two.
取 b = 0、c = 2：δ 的平方等于 2。
The spinor u is delta over two times one plus i, of squared length exactly one.
旋量 u = (δ/2)(1 + i)，模方恰好为 1。
Square it: i. Square again: minus one, a full turn that flips the sign. Once more: plus one.
平方一次得 i；再平方得 −1，转满一圈却翻了号；再平方回到 +1。
Eight beats, seven hundred twenty degrees, home. Lean checks unit length and eighth power.
八拍、720°，回到原位。Lean 检验其单位模方与八次幂。

scenes.name: GOLDEN PAIRS
lines: Set b and c to one: phi squared is phi plus one.
取 b = c = 1：φ² = φ + 1。
Each power of phi is a pair of neighbouring Fibonacci numbers; the twelfth is eighty-nine, one forty-four.
φ 的每个幂都是一对相邻的斐波那契数；第十二次幂是 (89, 144)。
Their norms alternate, minus one, plus one: Cassini's identity, in whole numbers.
它们的范数交替为 −1、+1：这就是卡西尼恒等式，全是整数。
Lean checks: the norm of phi to the n is minus one to the n.
Lean 检验：φⁿ 的范数等于 (−1)ⁿ，对一切 n 成立。

scenes.name: A DECAGON WITHOUT COSINE
lines: Run Chebyshev's recurrence on phi over two: every value stays a pair.
在 φ/2 上运行切比雪夫递推：每一个值都仍是数对。
Five steps land on minus one, ten return to one: the corners of a regular decagon.
五步精确落在 −1，十步回到 1：正是正十边形的顶点。
No cosine was taken. Lean checks both closures, and the companion value.
全程没有取余弦。Lean 检验这两处闭合，以及另一个根的值。

scenes.name: SQUARES, NOT ROOTS
lines: Positivity needs only fractions too. Take three pairs: one two, three one, two five.
正定性同样只需分数。取三个数对：(1, 2)、(3, 1)、(2, 5)。
Their Gram determinant is four twenty minus two twenty-five: one ninety-five.
它们的格拉姆行列式是 420 − 225 = 195。
The minors are minus five, one and thirteen; their squares also add to one ninety-five.
子式是 −5、1、13，平方和同样是 195。
Lean checks this Lagrange identity for every list of pairs: the Cauchy-Schwarz gap is a sum of squares.
Lean 对任意有理数对序列检验这条拉格朗日恒等式：柯西—施瓦茨亏量就是平方和。

scenes.name: RIGID BY ITS GRAM
lines: Last, rigidity, which Lean checks in the classical shadow.
最后是刚性，由 Lean 在经典阴影层检验。
A permutation that keeps every inner product of a spanning family extends to exactly one isometry.
保持张成族全部内积的置换，恰好延拓为唯一的等距。
Swap e one and two e two, and length one becomes length two: no isometry.
对换 e₁ 与 2e₂，长度 1 变成长度 2：不存在等距。
Keep e one alone, and it no longer spans: the identity and a reflection both extend it.
只留 e₁，它不再张成全平面：恒等映射与一次反射都是延拓。

scenes.name: END
lines: Pairs and squares: Volume Five turns them on the primes.
数对与平方和：第五卷将用它们直面素数。
